title: What happened in AI — Oct 13, 2026
intro: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon on DeepMind and Google Cloud, but the more actionable news for builders came from agent teams quantifying what works: LangChain's harness changes lifted a coding agent from Top 30 to Top 5 on Terminal Bench without a model change.
Open models are closing the gap on agent tasks, and the infrastructure underneath is being rebuilt for agent volume, from Anthropic's new version control system to Modal's mixed-hardware RL.
highlights: Gemini 4 Argon launches on DeepMind and Google Cloud, with a safety write-up.
LangChain: harness engineering took its coding agent from Top 30 to Top 5 on Terminal Bench.
LangChain evals: GLM-5 and MiniMax M2.7 match closed frontier models on core agent tasks.
Anthropic replaced its source control with an in-house system after a tenfold rise in merges per day.
Modal keeps RL stable across mixed-precision, mixed-accelerator samplers.
GitHub's secret classifier cuts median scan time by 86%.
